name: hallumaze-benchmark
description:
HalluMaze Benchmark Dataset
	


All 10 tested LLMs score significantly below a random walk on metacognitive recovery (p<0.001, Glass's δ=0.6–2.1). Frontier cost does not predict performance: GPT-4o ranks last (MEI=0.315), Claude-3.7-Sonnet ranks first (MEI=0.774).


	
		
		Dataset Description
	

HalluMaze measures metacognitive error recovery in LLMs through maze navigation. Models are exposed to "mirage" walls — passages that appear blocked but are traversable — testing real-time… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Be2Jay/hallumaze-benchmark.
reputation: Emerging research benchmark for studying LLM metacognition and recovery; limited adoption outside research groups interested in metacognitive behavior.
